listeners.doc: Opens authenticated Subscribe gRPC streams to the Salesforce Pub/Sub API for every attached topic and dispatches each decoded event, in topic order, to the service registered for that topic.

serviceTypes.doc: Receives decoded events published to the subscribed Salesforce Pub/Sub topic, delivered in topic order. Declare with the canonical topic path as the service's attach point, e.g. `service /event/MyEvent__e on listener { ... }` or `service "/event/MyEvent__e" on listener { ... }`. A service may also implement an optional `remote function onError(pubsub:ListenerError err) returns error?;` callback, invoked once with the terminal failure context when an unrecoverable subscription error stops the Listener; this is not part of the `Service` type itself, so add it by hand when you need it.
